title: ScriptCraft v0.2: feature tour of PR #33
sub: Every frame is the real app, driven through its own input (keys, clicks, drags)

title: #1  Bold, italic and underline
sub: Double-click a word, Cmd+B. Select a phrase, Cmd+I and Cmd+U. Kept in FDX, Fountain and PDF

title: #2  Spelling as you type (offline)
sub: Misspellings get a red underline; right-click for suggestions, Ignore or Add to Dictionary

title: #3  Element Settings
sub: Indents, spacing, alignment, capitals and Enter/Tab targets, per script (saved in FDX)

title: #4  Tab in an empty Action
sub: Character by default (Final Draft); here this script sets it to Transition

title: #5  Element list on Enter in an empty paragraph
sub: Arrows or 1-8 to pick, Return to choose, Esc to cancel

title: #6  Copy and paste keep elements
sub: Copy several paragraphs, paste anywhere: heading, cues and dialogue come back intact

title: #7  Index cards: colour, tags, drag to reorder
sub: Right-click a card for colour and tags; drag a card onto another to move the scene

title: #8  Autosave and crash recovery
sub: Killed with unsaved changes? The words come back at the next start

title: #8  Recent files and backups
sub: File > Open Recent; the previous version of a file is kept every time you save

title: #9  Fit Page Width, Speed View, blinking caret
sub: Zoom also with Ctrl/Cmd + wheel or pinch; Speed View has no page breaks

title: #10  Quit asks before losing work
sub: Cmd+Q with unsaved changes: Save, Don't Save or Cancel

title: #11  Safe on termination
sub: kill -TERM: unsaved words kept for recovery, control key removed; stale keys are reported

title: #12  ScriptCraft in the browser
sub: The same app compiled to WebAssembly: typing, SmartType, spelling and shortcuts in Chrome
